summary: Read the complete 35-page published paper and all 163 extraction items. Two medium findings: the Proposition 5.8 proof outline suppresses an actual quasi-projective-target obstruction and a change of ambient resolution hypothesis; three further printed proof slips are silently repaired or bypassed without sourceIssues. No counterexample to the paper's main MMP theorems is claimed. The known coherent-duality ownership consolidation is recorded as an existing follow-up, not a new finding.

The existing sourceIssues are real constraints on this audit, not new discoveries to report again: canonical versus log index, fixed versus varying coefficient sets, surface intersection signs, difficulty inequalities/domains, local versus global Q-Cartier deformation, numerical versus prescribed Picard lifts, codimension-one flip isomorphisms, trace ambient symbols and positive-degree slope bounds. The extraction retains the corresponding local/global and numerical/line-bundle guards. The source's main resolution assumptions remain explicit, not asserted as proved in characteristic p.

Inspected the quasi-resolution and rational-chain-connectedness supplier definitions. CR12 Definition 4.3.1 requires a topological finite-quotient source, projective surjective generically finite map and purely inseparable function-field extension. The extraction's exact source-class frontier is explicitly already recorded in gap-witt, so this audit does not relabel that acknowledged incompleteness as a newly discovered false definition.

findings.where: research/blueprint/papers/PAPER-HACON-WITASZEK-23.result.json: PAPER-HACON-WITASZEK-23/embedded-to-birational, proofSteps, gaps and sourceIssues; corresponding reader passage
findings.claim: The Proposition 5.8 item repeats a two-step principalization proof with gaps:[] although its first step cannot produce the claimed morphism to an arbitrary quasi-projective target. A second application of embedded resolution also changes the ambient variety from the fixed X in the hypothesis to X′ without establishing transfer of that hypothesis. These are defects in the supplied proof, not a demonstrated counterexample to the proposition's conclusion.
findings.evidence: Published p.26, Proposition 5.8: X is regular projective, Y only quasi-projective; after a projective birational modification X′→X, the proof invokes a 'corresponding morphism' f′:X′→Y. Take an algebraically closed field of characteristic >5, X=P¹ and Y=A¹, with their birational rational map. The embedded-resolution hypothesis on X holds for proper closed subschemes of the smooth curve. Every projective birational regular curve X′→P¹ is P¹, and H⁰(P¹,O)=k; consequently every morphism X′→A¹ is constant. Resolving the rational linear series produces a morphism to a projective closure, not an extension to A¹ on all of X′. The next paragraph applies Conjecture 5.7 on X′ although the stated assumption quantifies only over subschemes of X. The extraction's proofSteps repeats principalize-then-resolve without either adapter, and none of E1–E11 records this issue. The analogous target problem is also visible in arXiv v2 p.29; the finding is based on the published p.26.
findings.fix: Add a sourceIssues gap against published Proposition 5.8, affects:the proof, and link an explicit gap from embedded-to-birational. Construct the rational map to a projective compactification of Y, and restrict the resolved source to the inverse image of Y before producing a proper morphism to Y; prove the exceptional/boundary conclusions survive that restriction. Separately supply the transfer from principalization on all closed subschemes of this fixed X to the subsequent ambient variety, or replace the two applications by a justified simultaneous principalization on X. A provisional stronger theorem may assume embedded resolution for every relevant regular ambient variety, but must be labelled stronger than the printed hypothesis. Add the P¹/A¹ regression test forbidding a birational map from the entire projective modification to A¹. Do not mark the main MMP statements false on this evidence.

findings.where: research/blueprint/papers/PAPER-HACON-WITASZEK-23.result.json: sourceIssues; items echoes, witt-fourfold and partial-terminalization; corresponding reader source-diagnostics section
findings.claim: Three printed proof slips require explicit sourceIssues under Protocol §18. The extraction already signals corrections to echo centres and terminalization symbols, but none of E1–E11 records them; the Witt-rationality proof also needs an explicit correction of its direct-image target. A prose hint to correct symbols does not preserve the actual mathematical correction for the next worker.
findings.evidence: (a) Published p.12, proof of Proposition 2.15, defines successive echo blowups using 'strict transforms of C'. After the blowup of C its strict transform is empty. AHK07 v2 p.3, Example 1.4, instead takes C₁=E₁∩the strict transform of Bᵢ and iterates the analogous intersection. The extraction's echoes.proofSteps explicitly mentions this correction, but its sourceIssues do not. (b) Published p.19, proof of Corollary 4.7, starts with f:Y→Z over X but writes f_S:S→X and f_{Sν}:Sν→X. Its ensuing identification Rⁱf_*(u_*WO_S,Q)=Rⁱ(f_S)_*WO_S,Q has its left side on Z and its printed right side on X; the relative log-Fano vanishing also belongs over Z. The correct maps are restrictions to Z, followed later by Z→X and Leray. (c) Published p.30, last paragraph of Claim 6.8's proof, is proving terminality of the new total space 𝒴 but switches to discrepancies of (𝒳,0), the plt pair (𝒳,X), and the Cartier divisor X. It must use (𝒴,0), (𝒴,Y), and Y instead. For an exceptional vertical E, A_𝒴(E)=A_(𝒴,Y)(E)+ord_E(Y)>1 because the first term is positive and the second is an integer at least one. partial-terminalization.proofSteps signals source symbol switches without spelling out or registering this one. Page images verified all three printed passages.
findings.fix: Add three separate sourceIssues records, with the published locators above, brief exact printed excerpts, the respective intersection-centre/target/ambient corrections, reasons, affects:the proof and the actual correction-search record. Keep the intended theorem conclusions and existing E1–E11. Make echoes' recursive centre explicit and retain its discrepancy tests; state f_S=f∘u with codomain Z and perform pushforward to X only afterward; write the 𝒴 discrepancy identity with E exceptional and vertical. Link each item to its diagnostic and update the reader. These are limited proof corrections, not grounds to withdraw the termination, Witt-rationality or lifting theorems.
